title: Recovery playbooks
description: Safe first-response sequences. Diagnose before weakening security.

entries.title: Remote Desktop does not work
entries.value:
1. archctl desktop-restart
2. archctl vnc-logs
3. Verify Tailscale
4. Verify Hyprland/Wayland session
5. Open AVNC again
entries.description: Do not change network exposure or authentication as a first response.

entries.title: Private Share does not work
entries.value:
1. archctl share-restart
2. archctl share-logs
3. Check the private Serve URL
4. Generate a fresh one-time pairing QR
entries.description: Keep Serve private and regenerate pairing rather than reusing an expired credential.

entries.title: SSH does not work
entries.value:
1. Check the Tailscale app
2. Try ssh arch-pc
3. Locally check systemctl status sshd
4. Inspect SSH logs
entries.description: Diagnose connectivity and daemon state before changing SSH authentication.

entries.title: Tailscale does not work
entries.value:
1. tailscale status
2. systemctl status tailscaled
3. Restart only if needed
entries.description: Preserve SSH/local recovery while diagnosing the tailnet.

entries.title: Lock Sharing
entries.value:
LAN Share OFF
WayVNC OFF
Tailscale remains ON
SSH recovery remains ON
entries.description: Use the Arch Remote Lock Sharing action; no terminal command is required.
